selected_headlines: 18-year-old arrested in Port St. Lucie hit-and-run that critically injured scooter rider
source_headlines: Port St. Lucie police discuss hit-and-run crash that left scooter rider critically hurt - WPBF
novel_facts: The victim is a 24-year-old woman who was riding an electric scooter and suffered critical injuries.
Police say the driver fled without rendering aid.
Investigators identified the driver and located the vehicle.
Police arrested the 18-year-old driver and charged him with leaving the scene of a crash involving serious bodily injury.
Authorities allege the driver had participated in a "ding dong ditch" prank shortly before the crash.
